alternatives.option: Match on summary regex + entry_type only
alternatives.reason_rejected: looser than necessary; archaeology showed the tighter signature costs nothing

assumptions: The field repo's junk was generated exclusively by the archiver code paths present in git history (no forked/patched variants in the wild)
constraints: No commits, no version bumps, no CHANGELOG edits (controller merges)
archive/ is backend-agnostic plain files — pass must work under both file and sqlite backends
context: Fixed #35: added opt-in compact_archives pass to twining_housekeeping — streaming repair for archive/*.jsonl junk from the pre-1.24.0 auto-archive loop. Preview reports counts/bytes; execute compacts atomically, deletes emptied files, posts audit finding.
rationale: Git archaeology across every commit touching src/engine/archiver.ts (1135323→dfd6add) plus the blackboard post default (db64f9c) proved all six fields stable since inception, so the full conjunction loses no junk while making a false drop of a human/agent entry practically impossible. Corrupt/unparseable lines always survive.
summary: Junk signature requires all six archiver-stamped fields: entry_type finding, summary /^Archive: \d+ entries archived$/, tags including "archive", scope "project", agent_id "main", detail /^Archive summary: \d+ entries archived\./
